selection_rule: On an eligible wake, first deduplicate the event/state fingerprint and reuse fresh validated context. Build only the changed observations plus affected dependency closure. If no material work remains, emit NO_CHANGE and stop. Otherwise select exactly one highest-priority eligible bounded work unit. Stop on unmet dependencies, incomplete closure, missing evidence, budget exhaustion, cooldown or unknown outcome. No recurring clock is required.
context_rule: Default to the smallest sufficient evidence-bound delta. Expand to wider/full context whenever dependency closure is incomplete, DesignEpoch/source root changed, high-risk semantics cross owners, compact context cannot establish affected contracts/invariants, or whole-source assurance is required.
frontier_handoff_rule: A GardenFrontierReviewRequest/v1 may be emitted only after an explicit materiality receipt. The target lane is external ChatGPT, not OpenRouter; repository configuration does not hardcode a ChatGPT product model name. Frontier output is proposal evidence only.
blind_review_serialization: Persist one independent family result per material packet. Completed family results bound to an unchanged packet hash are reused. The next missing eligible family starts after completion; all allocated families must finish before cross-examination. Never lower review requirements to increase frequency or save compute.
cross_exam_rule: Cross-examination is eligible only when a new independent finding, contradiction or challenge exists. Do not rerun it on an unchanged review set.
transient_failure_rule: 429/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS never advances GardenProcess state. Persist Retry-After/exponential cooldown; resume only on a single eligible wake after that deadline. Interrupted or ambiguously charged calls require reconciliation before retry.
state_gating: Completion/materiality is a wake-up signal, not authority. CycleID, ProcessVersion, DesignEpoch, exact repository heads, packet hash, closure evidence and contiguous transition receipts determine eligibility.
algebra_rule: Every governed transition validates through REG-ALGEBRA-001. Scheduling/materiality/algebra conformance grants no authority and does not prove full semantic compliance.
execution_boundary: Each work unit has one handler and at most one provider call; a bounded worker wake may chain completed units sequentially. Event-driven context reuse does not permit parallel calls or change route/gate semantics.

wakeup_contract.repository_or_external_change: wake once for a new durable event fingerprint
wakeup_contract.material_context: frontier handoff only after reason-coded materiality receipt
wakeup_contract.bounded_wake_exhaustion: durable host must arrange continuation only while eligible work remains
wakeup_contract.cooldown: one deferred wake at or after persisted deadline; never hourly polling
wakeup_contract.freshness_deadline: wake only when an assurance/freshness obligation actually becomes due
wakeup_contract.empty_queue_or_unchanged_state: stop until a new event, completion, invalidation, deadline or human directive arrives
